retarget_report.insufficient_scale_anchor_policy: Only that hand receives zero new image targets; its continuous prior geometry and the other hand remain available. Scalar 1 is explicitly uncalibrated.
retarget_report.retargeting: One fixed raw-reference native/Ego 3D palm scalar per hand/clip, unchanged baseline native wrist depth, training-only fresh detector wrist lateral anchor. No per-frame scale, clamp, rotation fit or copied detector finger coordinate.
retarget_report.support_semantics: Shared detector wrist plus at least eight accepted finger points. Per-joint image support remains required. This heuristic does not establish true visibility, occlusion or confidence probability.
retarget_report.holdout_policy: Stride-5 detector coordinates/weights are excluded before crop/anchor/scale/gate construction. Unknown/heldout new image weights are zero; prior geometry remains. Observer inference, baseline and optional upstream smoothing remain transductive development inputs.
retarget_report.diagnostic_ablation: Unscaled 2D wrist translation is retained only for analysis; main retarget method was declared before neural rerun and is not chosen from evaluation scores.
retarget_report.mapping_limit: SOMA/full-body MHR anatomical landmarks and wrist definitions are approximate, not identical geometry.

original_geometry_adapter.mapping_limit: Approximate semantic correspondence; no equivalence of SOMA and full-body native MHR geometry is asserted.
original_geometry_adapter.coordinate_system: OpenCV camera: x right, y down, z forward; metres
original_geometry_adapter.targets: 3D model predictions projected into original-video pixels; not independent image detections
original_geometry_adapter.confidence_policy: Binary finite positive-depth source-image-and-frozen-crop admission; not visibility, calibrated confidence or reconstruction truth.
original_geometry_adapter.optional_model_signals: Crop presence and normalized-crop sigma are preserved without thresholding or visibility interpretation.
original_geometry_adapter.mirroring: No additional mirror; EgoHand anatomical outputs are already in source-camera coordinates.
original_geometry_adapter.missing_policy: Zero fitting weights on absent predictions; no interpolation, reindexing or invented targets.
original_geometry_adapter.holdout_policy: No fitting/validation frames are removed here; the same downstream original-frame holdout mask must be used for each method. Model image inference itself sees supplied frames.

retarget_report.camera_quality: Shared Track 1 estimate; native metric depth and scale are not calibrated truth.
